title: Reduce header brand text size on mobile (Webraft Agency)

requirements.summary: Make the SiteHeader brand text span use a smaller responsive font size on mobile while preserving the existing desktop (md+) size and styling.
acceptanceCriteria: On small/mobile viewports, the header brand text no longer overflows the header width or causes layout issues.
On desktop viewports (md and up), the brand text remains at the current visual size (equivalent to the existing text-2xl appearance).
Only the selected element’s text sizing is changed; no other header elements (nav, buttons, menu toggle) are modified.

file_operations.description: Update ONLY the brand text <span> within the header button (the element currently using "text-2xl") to use responsive Tailwind font-size classes (e.g., smaller on mobile, keep md+:text-2xl) so it fits on mobile without overflow, while preserving all other existing classes (font-bold, text-gradient) and leaving all other header elements unchanged.
